description.zh: 我在需要新工具时会先调研GitHub开源项目，比较已有方案，再根据具体需求阅读并修改代码。
description.en: When I need a new tool, I first research open-source projects on GitHub, compare existing approaches, and then read and modify code for the specific requirement.

description.zh: 我在本科毕业论文中收集、处理并可视化了中国服装产业出口隐含碳数据。
description.en: For my undergraduate thesis, I collected, processed and visualised data on embodied carbon in Chinese garment exports.

description.zh: Fashion Futures专业侧重可持续时尚；我的本科毕业论文测算了中国服装产业对外贸易隐含碳，属于产业层面的可持续研究。
description.en: The Fashion Futures programme focuses on sustainable fashion; my undergraduate thesis calculated the embodied carbon associated with foreign trade in the Chinese garment industry as industry-level sustainability research.

description.zh: Fashion Lab中的《墙》《灵》《根》覆盖从设计、样版和样衣到Fitting、修版与最终成衣的全过程。
description.en: Wall, Spirit and Root in Fashion Lab cover the full process from design, patterns and toiles through fitting, revision and final garments.

description.zh: 这些材料实践体现在我的服装作品集中。
description.en: These material practices appear throughout my fashion portfolio.

description.zh: 我曾完整制作一枚银黏土戒指。
description.en: I have completed a silver-clay ring from design to finish.

description.zh: 我担任GLITCH IN THE HIVE的导演，并负责把概念、表演、摄影、声音与后期统一为完整影片。
description.en: I directed GLITCH IN THE HIVE, bringing its concept, performance, cinematography, sound and post-production together as a complete film.

description.zh: 我在GLITCH IN THE HIVE中担任摄影指导之一，并参与Reference搜集、勘景和整体画面方向的建立；也完成并主导过Fashion Lab中时尚成衣的成片拍摄。
description.en: I was one of the directors of photography on GLITCH IN THE HIVE and contributed to reference research, location scouting and the overall visual direction; I also led and completed the finished-garment photography for Fashion Lab.

description.zh: 我主导编写了GLITCH IN THE HIVE的叙事与台词。
description.en: I led the narrative and dialogue writing for GLITCH IN THE HIVE.

description.zh: 我在GLITCH IN THE HIVE中参与剪辑，并独立负责主要后期制作，包括素材组织、调色、特效、配音和声音整合。
description.en: I contributed to the edit of GLITCH IN THE HIVE and independently handled its main post-production work, including media organisation, grading, effects, voice and sound integration.

description.zh: 个人作品发布在我的音乐页面。
description.en: My original work is published on my music page.

description.zh: 我为自己的音乐和影视作品进行混音与声音设计，并在GLITCH IN THE HIVE中负责音乐和声音。
description.en: I mix and design sound for my own music and film work, and was responsible for music and sound on GLITCH IN THE HIVE.

description.zh: 我在《幻》中独立完成了从3D设计、建模、材质与场景到动画和最终渲染的全部流程。
description.en: For Huan, I independently completed the entire process from 3D design, modelling, materials and scenes through animation and final rendering.

description.zh: 相关代码与小型工具持续维护在GitHub。
description.en: Related code and small tools are maintained on GitHub.

description.zh: 我在伦敦时装学院Fashion Futures的学习与作品中，以哲学、社会推论和跨学科研究发展推测性设计命题。
description.en: In my Fashion Futures study and work at London College of Fashion, I developed speculative design propositions through philosophy, social inference and interdisciplinary research.

description.zh: 我在Digital Alchemy中使用文生图、图生视频、首尾帧和提示词流程制作AIGC影像，并将生成素材纳入调色与后期。
description.en: In Digital Alchemy, I used text-to-image, image-to-video, first-and-last-frame and prompting workflows to create AIGC footage and integrate it into grading and post-production.

description.zh: 我独立搭建了个人网站，也完成过多个网页设计案例和小型工具，并持续在GitHub维护相关代码。
description.en: I built my personal website independently, completed multiple web-design projects and small tools, and continue to maintain related code on GitHub.

description.zh: 我长期在GitHub调研开源项目，并按实际需求修改代码。
description.en: I regularly research open-source projects on GitHub and modify code for practical needs.

description.zh: 我接入过AI语言模型与生成式API，并将它们用于网站自动化流程以及Unity程序的交互实验。
description.en: I have integrated language-model and generative APIs into automated web workflows and interactive experiments in Unity.

description.zh: 我在Unity与TouchDesigner之间使用过OSC或MIDI通信，也使用串口和Mac虚拟MIDI协调软件、音频与硬件。
description.en: I have used OSC or MIDI between Unity and TouchDesigner, as well as serial communication and virtual MIDI on macOS to coordinate software, audio and hardware.

description.zh: 我用STM32制作过家庭自动浇水系统，也用Arduino协助完成过带有灯光交互的服装项目。
description.en: I built an automated home-watering system with STM32 and used Arduino to help create fashion projects with interactive lighting.

description.zh: 我从初中开始自行组装电脑，后来也为他人装过多台设备，包括ITX主机，并保持整洁的内部理线。
description.en: I began building my own computers in middle school and later assembled multiple systems for other people, including ITX builds with clean internal cable management.

description.zh: 我把家用服务器配置为同时运行NAS和软路由的虚拟化双系统，也改造过机顶盒承担网络出口与影音服务。
description.en: I configured a home server as a virtualised dual system running both NAS and soft-router services, and repurposed a set-top box for network gateway and media services.

description.zh: 我的筋膜枪电池亏电后，我自行判断问题、购买替换电池并完成拆机、焊接与更换。
description.en: When the battery in my massage gun failed, I diagnosed the problem, sourced a replacement and completed the disassembly, soldering and battery change myself.

description.zh: 我为个人声音创作搭建过录音系统，能够根据电容麦与动圈麦的差异配置麦克风、路由和基础声学处理。
description.en: I have built recording systems for my own sound work, configuring microphones, routing and basic acoustic treatment according to the differences between condenser and dynamic microphones.

description.zh: 在GLITCH IN THE HIVE的制作中，我与摄影、演员和服装成员协作，同时承担导演、表演、后期与声音等多项职责。
description.en: During GLITCH IN THE HIVE, I collaborated with cinematography, cast and costume contributors while also taking responsibility across direction, performance, post-production and sound.

description.zh: 我曾教授他人CLO3D的基础操作，并讲解数字服装从样版到三维模拟的基本流程。
description.en: I have taught CLO3D fundamentals, explaining the basic digital-garment workflow from patterns to three-dimensional simulation.

description.zh: 我在影片制作中使用DaVinci Resolve Project Server组织局域网协作，并设计素材整理、剪辑、调色、特效与声音交付流程。
description.en: In film production, I used DaVinci Resolve Project Server for local-network collaboration and designed workflows for media organisation, editing, grading, effects, sound and delivery.

description.zh: 我长期追踪AI与前沿技术资讯，并通过开源项目、软件文档和实际搭建持续更新自己的知识。
description.en: I continually follow AI and emerging-technology developments, updating my knowledge through open-source projects, software documentation and practical building.

description.zh: 我曾用五天从杭州骑行到南京。
description.en: I completed a five-day cycle from Hangzhou to Nanjing.

description.zh: 我曾在挪威和希腊扎金索斯独立完成海外自驾。
description.en: I have completed independent self-drive travel in Norway and on Zakynthos, Greece.

description.zh: 我有大量独立旅行和生活经验，并独立准备过英国签证、多次申根签证和十年美国签证的全部材料。
description.en: I have extensive independent travel and living experience and prepared all documentation myself for a UK visa, multiple Schengen visas and a ten-year US visa.

description.zh: 我长期独立做饭，实践涵盖多种类型的菜肴。
description.en: I have cooked independently over many years across a broad range of dishes.

description.zh: 我长期使用手冲、手压和气动咖啡设备。
description.en: I have long used pour-over, manual-pressure and pneumatic coffee equipment.

description.zh: 我的围棋水平为业余三段。
description.en: I play Go at amateur 3-dan level.

description.zh: 我曾用Arduino协助制作服装灯光交互，将电路、控制逻辑与可穿着结构结合。
description.en: I have used Arduino to help create interactive garment lighting, combining circuits and control logic with wearable structures.

description.zh: 我在SonySIE合作项目中把声音参数映射到TouchDesigner中的3D模型与实时视觉变化。
description.en: In the SonySIE collaboration, I mapped sound parameters onto 3D models and real-time visual changes in TouchDesigner.

description.zh: 我在SonySIE合作项目中把实时声音、3D视觉和交互表演组织为同一套运行系统；大学期间也做过现场声控，会少量现场设备操作和接线。
description.en: In the SonySIE collaboration, I organised real-time sound, 3D visuals and interactive performance into a single operating system; at university I also handled live sound control and gained some experience operating and cabling equipment.

description.zh: 我为Obfuscation Identity Archive搭建了从SurveyJS问卷、AI生图和GitHub归档到前端更新与Vercel部署的全自动流程。
description.en: For Obfuscation Identity Archive, I built an automated workflow from SurveyJS responses, AI image generation and GitHub archiving through frontend updates and Vercel deployment.

description.zh: 我把wiki-agent、本地Wiki、MCP与Zotero连接起来，用于个人知识库整理和带有可追溯来源的学术写作。
description.en: I connected wiki-agent, a local Wiki, MCP and Zotero for personal knowledge-base organisation and academic writing with traceable sources.

description.zh: 我在服装作品中把折纸结构转化为廓形和样版，并通过立裁与Fitting验证其可穿着性。
description.en: In my fashion work, I translated origami structures into silhouettes and patterns, testing their wearability through draping and fitting.
